critical_findings.title: Inconsistent order count between 'Vue d'ensemble' card and 'Suivi en direct' card
critical_findings.evidence: Screenshot ADV-MEGA-S11-dashboard.png shows 'Total commandes 0' (purple card) AND 'Commandes du Jour 67' (blue card) at the same time. The labels imply both are 'today' metrics but render contradictory counts.
critical_findings.owner_impact: Owner glance sees zero AND sixty-seven — credibility hit on the daily dashboard.
critical_findings.recommendation: Either fix the 'Total commandes' query (it appears to be from a different scope — perhaps total-orders-table-empty) or relabel the cards to clarify the scope difference (e.g., 'Commandes en cours' vs 'Commandes encaissées aujourd'hui'). Defer to V1.0.X cosmetic backlog — not a blocker.

critical_findings.title: 39 console errors on /login page due to stale-token axios fan-out before authentication
critical_findings.evidence: Playwright console capture: 13 unique /api/admin/dashboard/* endpoints each fired 401 twice (≈26 errors) + login axios chain. Each /api/admin/* call fires before login completes because the SPA hydrates dashboard widgets eagerly when the route is /admin/dashboard (post-login redirect target).
critical_findings.impact: Noise in dev console; production noise on every owner login; potential pager false alarms if observability picks this up.
critical_findings.recommendation: Defer the eager fetch until after auth state is hydrated, OR collapse the 401 chain via interceptor that suppresses logging when auth is in 'initializing' state. Backlog V1.0.X UX polish.

critical_findings.scope: Cron lane naming drift vs documentation
critical_findings.title: Scenario 8 expected 'fiscal:close + fiscal:open' but actual command names are 'fiscal:close-all-active-branches' + 'fiscal:open-all-active-branches'
critical_findings.evidence: app/Console/Kernel.php:361 and :406 use the suffixed multi-branch sweep variants. CLAUDE.md §8 and supervisor reports use the short alias for narrative shorthand.
critical_findings.impact: Adversarial dispute: a future agent that greps for 'fiscal:close' in Kernel.php might miss the lane and flag a false negative. NO operational impact — sweep variant is strictly safer than the single-branch literal.
critical_findings.recommendation: Add a docblock comment near each schedule line aliasing the short name, OR add `fiscal:close` and `fiscal:open` as deprecated aliases pointing to the multi-branch commands. Pure process hygiene.

verdict_short: 0 vulnerabilities found across 12 hostile scenarios. 9 plain PROTECTED. Scenarios 10 (cumulative frozen-zone vs main = explained-via-LOCK-docs) and 11 (one P2 cosmetic UX nit CF-1) are PROTECTED-WITH-CAVEAT. Scenario 6 backend pipeline measured 1s (occurred_at → dispatched_at via outbox row #294); browser-side UI catalog refresh < 2s not directly observable in this session because /broadcasting/auth needs the runtime sanctum token, which my dynamically-eval'd Echo subscription lacked. Follow-up live test with sanctum-token-injected browser context recommended before declaring sync SLO closed.
verdict_justification: Zero vulnerabilities despite maximum-hostility scenarios across code-level (gate inspection), runtime (curl as actual POS Operator user, not admin bypass), and live (Playwright login + screenshot + Echo private channel subscription + audit-chain re-verify after probes). NF525 chain CHAIN OK exit 0 BOTH before and after the RED-team probes. Frozen-zone diff in the recent 3-day window is genuinely 0 LOC; cumulative diff vs main covered by 9 LOCK docs. The 3 findings (CF-1 P2 UX, CF-2 P3 noise, CF-3 P3 process) are non-blockers.
